description: Compare expected memberships with stored items in the authorized tracking group, including missing/extra items, platform mismatches and optional stored refresh-job status. Omit expected_items to inspect current membership. Reads existing configuration/jobs only; no collection, refresh, mutation or new cost. Completeness does not establish fresh evidence. Reuse the workspace from socialseal_list_tracking_groups; for the workspace-wide total use socialseal_get_tracking_inventory.

platform.description: Optional platform-name constraint, compared with the joined stored platform name.

region.description: Optional region constraint; omitted matches any stored region for this tuple.

group_id.description: Tracking group ID returned by a group lookup; retain its workspace context.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace override. Omit only when the user can reach a single workspace.

name: socialseal_get_tracking_group_completeness

fieldPaths.description: Deduplicated JSON pointer patterns (* matches array elements) into source payloads before text truncation and existing structuredContent.result or structuredContent. Original structured values are unchanged.

title: Read tracking group completeness
